name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
January 22, 2019
7:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-04
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-735
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 7)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
January 9, 2019; Special Meeting
b.
January 9, 2019; Regular Meeting
c.
January 11, 2019; Special Meeting
Minutes
2.
Demands of January 22, 2019
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of January 11, 2019
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of January 22, 2019
Demands
3.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
4.
Special Event Permit Review of Lunada Bay and Palos Verdes Little League Organization's Annual Opening Day Parades Scheduled for Saturday, February 23, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the Special Event Applications of the Lunada Bay Little League and Palos Verdes Little League Organization's Annual Opening Day Parades Saturday, February 23, 2019, and provide direction in reference to funding staff overtime costs.
Staff Report
5.
Reference Calendar of 2019 Meetings and Holidays
Recommendation: Receive and file.
Staff Report
6.
Corrective Resolution R19-01 (R19-01C); Correcting the Resolution Title and Project Description for Denying the Appeal and Affirming the Planning Commission Approval of NC-1626-18; Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a Remodel and Addition to an Existing Single-Family Residence Located at 1509 Espinosa Circle
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R19-01C; denying the appeal and affirming Planning Commission approval of NC-1626-18.
Staff Report
7.
Adoption of Resolution R19-03; Approving the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Estates Police Officers Association
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R19-03 approving the Memorandum of Understanding amending the terms and conditions of employment for the Police Officers’ Association effective January 22, 2019.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
8.
Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval NC-1624/G-1617/M-1258-18; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading Permit, and Miscellaneous Applications for Additions and Remodeling to the Single-Family Residence and Walls Exceeding the Allowable Height Located 421 Via Media. Lots 12 & 13, Block 1511, Tract 6886. (Resolution No. PCR-2018-1070) (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: Continued to February 12, 2019.
Staff Report
9.
Continued Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval NC-1635/G-1623-18; Neighborhood Compatibility and Grading Permit for the Construction of a Single-Family Residence Located at 629 Via Del Monte. Lot 8, Block 1615, Tract 6884. (Resolution No. PCR-2018-1096) (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
10.
Discussion of Planning Commission/Council Landscaping Approval Process
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss how to proceed in addressing its jurisdiction and/or process for regulating landscaping on private property and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
11.
Consideration of Implementing an Integrated Pest Management Policy
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for implementing an integrated pest management policy and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
12.
Discussion and Review of Work Plan Priorities Discussed at December 17, 2018 Joint Meeting of the City Council & Planning Commission
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review the summary of its meeting with the Planning Commission on December 17, 2018 and provide direction for staff to develop a work plan to address findings of the discussion.
Staff Report
13.
Quarterly Report of Cash & Investments – December 31, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and file.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
14.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
15.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 12, 2019, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
i.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 18th day of January, 2019.
